paper_title: Knowing You Don't Know Learning When to Continue Search in Multi-round   RAG through Self-Practicing
caption: Ablation study on different Inner Monologue turns on HotPotQA. The green line represents the Naive Generation baseline, while the blue line shows the performance of SIM-RAGlite. The red line indicates the EM score using the ground-truth label as an Oracle Critic.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of Turns of Inner Monologue and the EM (%) score for three different models. The x-axis, labeled "Turns of Inner Monologue", has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 6 with a tick label interval of 1. The y-axis, labeled "EM (%)", also has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 50 with a tick label interval of 10. The plot displays three lines: the red line represents SIM-RAG (Oracle Critic), the blue line represents SIM-RAG (lite), and the green line represents Naive Gen. The red line, marked with crosses, starts at approximately 20% EM at 0 turns and increases to around 46% EM at 6 turns, with a notable increase between 0 and 1 turns, rising from 20% to 30%, and then continues to rise steadily to 46% at 6 turns. The blue line, also marked with crosses, begins at around 15% EM at 0 turns and increases to approximately 31% EM at 6 turns, showing a steady rise throughout the range. The green line remains constant at around 20% EM across all turns, with no visible change.
